author: Akien
prose: homogenize commands in something like domains. 'cairn operator show artifact x' well, yes, operators might be interested in seeing artifacts. i sure was. but i couldn't remember we put this in operator. it could just as easily been 'cairn codemother show artifact' or even 'cairn codemother show x' and it could have a list of things it knows how to show and could have code that would deduce without llm or graph tree (learning from llm) as to which thing to use. it could even have been 'cairn cc show x' or 'cairn aider show x' because all of those are concerned with the domain of coding. this would mean the devices would have to belong to domains, and they would inherit that domains commands and such. now whether 'domain' is the right box to put this in or not isn't really the point... if that doesn't make sense then it's not important, we can crate another top level container... but cairn, operator, codemother, cc, aider, all could be 'asked questions' (because that's what commands like show are doing) about our projects. on the other hand, maybe the more sensible, and simple, way is just to say codemother is the only responsible entity and should be the only one repling to those. and harbormaster just show the map. and operator becomes about my mail things awaiting me. but that once i start folloing a artifact inspection say, i move from me to codemonkey... like clicking a link in my root page points me to codemother's root page. or something like that. having typed all that out, i think i like the consolidation better. what do you think?
